use_cases: Sealing vapor barrier membranes and foil laps
Securing and retaining bulk insulation batts in wall, ceiling, and floor cavities
Spacing insulation to maintain compliant ventilation air gaps
retrieval.rag_summary:
Misc
Accessory refers to general-purpose insulation installation accessories
including mechanical impaling pins, retaining washers, foil joining tapes, and
insulation knives used across Australian building projects. These components
ensure insulation panels, batts, and membranes are correctly secured, sealed,
and aligned to maintain designed thermal and acoustic performance without
sagging or air leakage.
